algorithm_detail: At each draw, choose a feasible image with the fewest previously selected QA pairs across all types; break ties by SHA256 of seed|split|image|image_id. Within that image take the first feasible question ordered by SHA256 of seed|split|question|question_id. Feasible means unseen and below its type quota (validation only). Stop at the total limit or exhaustion. Hash ties use numeric IDs. Input order is irrelevant. No replacement; test questions are never read or selected.
image_hash_algorithm: SHA256 of complete source TIFF bytes
image_path_base: Explicit image_root pointing to the canonical Images_LR directory

policy.basis: B3 positive-area cross-split footprint intersections; official metadata unchanged; no distance buffer
